# Observe-close for #7570 — earlier Sep 11 recorded merges: all 84 verified stranded, verified replacements on rebuilt main

Issue #7570 carried a lead from the #6770 verification work: a REST read of
PRs merged on 2026-09-11 in Nishfleet/0509 yielded 159 records, and local
ancestry probes against green production head
`80d555a7ad607347fc5684de2d6177191c5d564d` returned nonzero for 84 earlier
records outside the 36-entry recovery list. The issue asked to distinguish
missing local objects from actual non-ancestry first, verify the recorded
SHAs and any replacement trees and ancestry before mapping, keep the #6770
recovery bounded to its 36 rows, and rewrite no history and weaken no gate.

## What was found

1. **Zero missing objects.** All 159 recorded `mergeCommit.oid` values
   resolve to commit objects in the local clone
   (`~/workspaces/products/0509`, a `blob:none` promisor clone fetched
   2026-09-22; `git cat-file --batch-check` — plumbing that reports
   `missing` instead of triggering a promisor fetch — returns `commit`
   for every record). The earlier nonzero probes were true non-ancestry,
   not absent objects.
2. **120 of 159 records are genuinely stranded; the other 39 are
   ancestors.** `git merge-base --is-ancestor <recorded> 80d555a7` splits
   the day cleanly at the rewrite window: every record merged
   2026-09-11T00:18:31Z through 14:49:43Z is a non-ancestor (120 total =
   the 36 listed in #6770 plus exactly the 84 earlier records the issue
   counted), and every record merged 16:52:24Z through 23:17:19Z — after
   the ~14:49–17:01 UTC force-push rebuilt `main` — is an ancestor of the
   green head. No stranded SHA is an ancestor of current `origin/main`
   (`9e8ad503d`), so all 120 are on the orphaned pre-rewrite chain.
3. **All 84 earlier records have verified replacements on rebuilt main.**
   For each stranded merge, `git rev-parse <sha>^{tree}` matched exactly
   one commit on `origin/main` (`git log origin/main --format=%H%x09%T%x09%s`
   over 5,932 commits), and that match's subject is the same
   `Merge pull request #<N>` line naming the same PR number and carries the
   same committer timestamp — byte-identical merge results, the same checks
   #6770 used to verify #2947. Every one of the 84 replacements is itself an
   ancestor of green head `80d555a7`
   (Deploy production run 34881391533), satisfying the map's admission rule.
4. **Method validated against the prior verified set.** The same tree-match
   run over the 36 listed records reproduces all 36 entries of the stranded-
   merge map exactly as it last existed on main — zero mismatches — so the
   84 new pairs carry the same confidence as the entries the gate shipped.
5. **Both records the issue names check out.** 0509#2708 recorded
   `0bbfb3d02e0e80252d65508edeb230ad305e75d1` (merged 2026-09-11T02:10:29Z) →
   replacement `73ff3542aaa516ed5370595acfd0daa7e88d3f5e`; 0509#2741 recorded
   `7b6b6809e07e8696b650f468a103ce75714f3730` → replacement
   `2a8ddf22f6f045fcf68da8b6d9df65a66a5506fa`. Both stranded, both replaced,
   both replacements green-head ancestors.
6. **There is no live map to extend.** `config/deploy-fault-stranded-merges.json`
   and `lib/deploy-fault-gate.sh` were deleted in `d7d69d813`
   ("chore(glue-sweep): cut the market-signal cron and four zero-caller
   orphans", 2026-09-18) after their last callers were removed; the map had
   already been completed to all 36 entries by #7563. #6770 stays bounded at
   its 36 rows per this issue — the verified pairs below are the record any
   future consumer adds one line at a time.
